visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and vibrant pink highlights stands in front of a minimalist grey wall. She holds a white smartphone showing a pink app interface, and several NTD 1000 bills are visible on a table in front of her. Large yellow text with a pink outline appears. (2) The woman holds up three fingers with a friendly smile, indicating a sequence of steps. Text describing the registration process overlays the screen. (3) The scene shifts to a bright graphic background featuring a mock 'Republic of China ID card' and a cartoon character with green hair. A table is displayed showing a schedule of registration dates categorized by the last digits of ID numbers. (4) A vertical screen recording of a smartphone interface shows a Google search for '10000' and navigation to the official website '10000.gov.tw'. The website has a pink and white color scheme. (5) The screen recording continues, demonstrating the process of clicking 'Registration for Account' and filling out digital forms with personal data such as ID number and bank account details. (6) The woman returns to the frame, holding NTD bills in her hand while a digital 'money rain' effect falls across the screen. She looks directly into the lens and speaks expressively.
